Class Portfolio

java.lang.Object
com.exchange.model.Portfolio
public class Portfolio extends Object
Manages an investor's active equity holdings, transaction audit history, and financial metrics.
Since:
1.0

    • addHolding

      public void addHolding(String symbol, int quantity, double purchasePrice)
      Records a new acquisition of shares, updating existing positions or opening new ones.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the equity ticker symbol
      quantity - the number of shares acquired
      purchasePrice - the execution price per share

    • removeHolding

      public double removeHolding(String symbol, int quantity, double sellPrice)
      Liquidates shares from an existing position, reducing share count and realizing gains/losses.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the equity ticker symbol
      quantity - the number of shares to sell
      sellPrice - the prevailing execution price
      Returns:
      the realized profit or loss generated by this liquidation
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the position does not exist or has insufficient shares

    • recordTransaction
